name: find_similar_incidents
description: How many colleagues reported the same system broken in the last few minutes, and whether there's already a major incident. Call after check_service_status for any app or network issue.

service.description: The app or system that's broken, e.g. VPN, Slack, Wi-Fi.

location.description: The caller's office (from lookup_employee), if known.

employee_id.description: The caller's ID, so their own tickets aren't counted.
